name: Collection Story
summary: Named editorial section with optional media, required narrative, optional quotation, and target-owned actions.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Native thematic section named by its visible collection-story heading and establishing the inline-size container.

anatomy.name: layout
anatomy.description: Internal container-responsive layout that preserves media-before-content source order.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Optional passive collection media region, omitted completely when no media is supplied.

anatomy.name: mediaImage
anatomy.description: Native collection image supplied by the target with context-appropriate alternative text.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Optional editorial label before the visible title.

anatomy.name: inspiration
anatomy.description: Optional native block quotation when the inspiration is genuinely quoted content.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Optional ordinary action group composed from canonical Button or other target-owned native controls; it is not automatically a navigation landmark.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic composition that splits media and narrative only when media is present and the component container is wide enough.

states.name: default
states.description: Required title and narrative content with any accepted optional parts.

states.name: withMedia
states.description: Explicit media-present composition that enables the intrinsic two-column split. Adapters omit the modifier when optional media is absent.

behavior.name: sectionLabelling
behavior.description: The native section references a target-unique id on its visible contextual heading; heading rank remains owned by the surrounding document.

behavior.name: narrativeOrder
behavior.description: Adapters preserve media before label, title, body, quotation, and actions in source order even when reversed changes only wide visual placement.

behavior.name: containerComposition
behavior.description: The root establishes an inline-size container; the internal layout stacks in narrow containers, splits only with media in wide containers, and remains one centered narrative column when media is absent.

behavior.name: mediaAlternative
behavior.description: The target supplies useful alternative text for informative media or an empty alternative for decorative or redundant media and omits the entire media region when absent.

behavior.name: optionalContent
behavior.description: Optional parts are omitted without empty shells, placeholder actions, reserved columns, or changes to the required title/body order.

behavior.name: quotationSemantics
behavior.description: Inspiration uses a native blockquote only when it is quoted from another source. Any attribution or citation remains separate target-authored content.

behavior.name: actionComposition
behavior.description: The group adds no landmark or composite-widget semantics. Canonical Button or target-native links/buttons own destinations, activation, focus, disabled, busy, hover and pressed behavior.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Rich, localized and unbroken content wraps inside the actual container; actions wrap as a group without page-level overflow.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: Collection Story owns no controlled or uncontrolled state, listener, observer, live region, focus movement or animation. Content safety, media loading, routing and analytics remain target responsibilities.

properties.name: reversed
properties.description: Places media after narrative content in the intrinsic wide composition without changing source order; it is a layout property, not a state or variant.

properties.name: media
properties.description: Target-owned passive collection media with informative or decorative native alternative text as context requires.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional editorial label shown before the collection-story title.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Visible collection-story heading; its contextual native heading level remains target-owned.

properties.name: inspiration
properties.description: Optional genuine inspiration quotation; attribution remains separate target-owned content.

properties.name: actions
properties.description: Optional target-owned calls to action; canonical Button or target-native controls retain their own semantics and destinations without making the section interactive.

accessibility: Associate the native section with its visible contextual heading through a target-unique aria-labelledby/id pair.
Use a heading level appropriate to the surrounding page for the title; the visual class does not mandate h2.
Give informative media concise useful alternative text, use an empty alternative for decorative or redundant media, and omit the media region when absent.
Preserve media-before-narrative source order when reversed changes only wide visual placement.
Use blockquote only for content genuinely quoted from another source and keep attribution outside the quotation.
Keep composed actions native and keyboard accessible with canonical visible focus without making the section a navigation landmark.
Keep meaning complete when media, optional parts, CSS or JavaScript are unavailable.
Allow localized, unbroken, RTL and zoomed content to reflow without page-level horizontal overflow.

web.notes: Implemented in components/css/storytelling.css with named inline-size containment and no component runtime.

shopify.notes: Dedicated merchant-configurable Liquid section maps optional image metadata, label, required narrative fields, quotation, native Button action and visual reversal without neutral runtime.
